elements.title: fictional planets of the Solar System (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that fictional planets of the Solar System (diagram pictured) include planets between Venus and Earth, planets on the inside of a hollow Earth, and a planet "behind the Earth"?

elements.title: Sonya Friedman (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Sonya Friedman developed the idea of supertitles, which translate words being sung on stage in opera?

elements.title: Papa (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that multiple scenes in Papa feature cotton-tree flowers, even though it was not scripted and the falling cotton simply kept drifting into the shot?

elements.title: Apt Exact (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Canadian rapper Apt Exact, who has been described as "not gangster", was elected to the Legislative Assembly of British Columbia in 2024?

elements.title: schools in Wales during the Second World War (Wikipedia — did you know?)

elements.title: Kathryn Maple (Wikipedia — did you know?)

elements.title: the Manhasset (Wikipedia — did you know?)
